title: Countable Annual Income for a Waiver Request — Benefit Overpayment Accounts Worksheet
content:
On Benefit Overpayment Accounts, a request no longer awaiting decision is not completed and keeps the income it carries. An annual household income recorded as 0.00 on a request is the record of a request lodged without any income figure; a request on which the claimant wrote an income figure keeps the figure the claimant wrote, and the income the claimant confirms on completion becomes the claimant's own statement of income on the application.

## Which income is entered

For a household of one person, the income entered is the claimant's countable annual income worked out from the Department's own records; for a household of more than one person the income stays as the claimant lodged it, because the other members' income comes only from the claimant's written figures, and nothing is worked out on a call. The household size and the income are those on the waiver request.

| Request awaiting decision | Income on the request | Household size on the request | Income entered on completion |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | 0.00 | 1 | The countable annual income |
| Yes | 0.00 | More than 1 | The income as lodged |
| Yes | A figure the claimant wrote | Any | The figure the claimant wrote |
| No | Any | Any | None; the request is not completed |

## The countable annual income

The countable annual income is the unemployment benefits paid to the claimant, counted by the date each payment was issued, plus the gross earnings the claimant reported for certified weeks, taking the entries of the income window of the three whole months before the handling date, with the sum multiplied by the annualizing multiplier of 4, never less than zero and rounded to the cent.

An entry falls in the income window when the whole months from its date to the handling date are fewer than the window's 3 months; a certified week is dated by the Saturday ending it.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

Handling date 20 June; a household of one; the request awaits decision with 0.00 income.

| Record | In the window | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Benefit payment issued 20 March | No: three whole months before 20 June | — |
| Benefit payments issued 27 March to 12 June | Yes | USD 3,200.00 |
| Gross earnings for certified weeks ending 5 April to 13 June | Yes | USD 600.00 |

The sum is USD 3,800.00; multiplied by 4 it is USD 15,200.00, which is the income entered.
